units.characteristics: God's elective love met by a doubting heart
units.gist: DISPUTATION 1 - 'I have loved you' / 'How have you loved us?'; Jacob loved, Esau hated - divine love asserted against a heart that cannot feel it; the doubting interior answered by election

units.characteristics: honour and fear withheld from God; the corrupted priestly covenant
units.gist: DISPUTATION 2 (crosses 1->2) - 'a son honours his father... where is my honour? my fear?'; the priests despising God's name with polluted offerings; against it the covenant with Levi (life, peace, fear, awe, true instruction on the lips) now corrupted - reverence as the interior owed and refused

units.characteristics: faithlessness vs covenant-faithfulness; guarding one's spirit
units.gist: DISPUTATION 3 - 'have we not all one Father?'; faithlessness to the wife of your youth, the covenant-companion whom the LORD witnessed; 'guard yourselves in your spirit, let none be faithless' - covenant-loyalty as an inner watch

units.characteristics: wearying God with cynicism; the doubted justice; the refiner
units.gist: DISPUTATION 4 (crosses 2->3) - 'you have wearied the LORD... Where is the God of justice?'; the cynical heart that calls evil good; answered by the messenger/refiner who purifies the sons of Levi - the doubting-of-justice interior met by a coming purification

units.characteristics: the withholding heart; 'return to me'; the test of trust
units.gist: DISPUTATION 5 - 'return to me and I will return to you' / 'How shall we return?'; robbing God in tithes; 'put me to the test' - the grasping/withholding interior invited to a trust that proves God

units.characteristics: the God-doubting heart vs those who feared the LORD; the book of remembrance
units.gist: DISPUTATION 6 (crosses 3->4) - 'it is vain to serve God... evildoers prosper and escape'; against it those who FEARED the LORD spoke together, and a book of remembrance was written; the distinction between one who serves God and one who does not - the cynical vs the reverent-remembering interior

units.characteristics: remember the law; the turning of hearts (fathers<->children)
units.gist: EPILOGUE - remember the law of Moses; Elijah will come and turn the hearts of fathers to children and children to fathers - memory and the reconciled interior across generations
